# OneSheet — Platform Documentation for LLMs

> OneSheet is a resume builder for developers. Users write resumes in Markdown,
> pick a template, and export a pixel-perfect one-page PDF or share a public link.
> Website: https://onesheet.cv

---

## API Overview

Base URL: https://onesheet.cv
Auth: X-Api-Key header (Pro subscription required)
Rate limit: 60 requests/min per key, 10 PDF exports/hour
OpenAPI spec: https://onesheet.cv/openapi.json

---

## Agent Workflow

When helping a user build a resume with OneSheet:

1. INTERVIEW — Ask about experience, education, skills, and target role.
   Ask follow-up questions for anything vague. Get specific numbers and metrics.

2. CHOOSE TEMPLATE — Suggest based on their role:
   - "classic" — Traditional serif, ATS-friendly (corporate/finance/legal)
   - "modern" — Clean sans-serif with color (tech/startups)
   - "minimal" — Maximum whitespace (senior/executive)
   - "technical" — Monospace (engineers/DevOps)
   - "compact" — Two-column dense (lots of experience)

3. DRAFT — Write in Markdown (see format below). Keep to one page.

4. REVIEW — Show the draft. Ask for changes. Never proceed without approval.

5. PUBLISH — POST /api/agent/resumes to create, PUT to update.

6. EXPORT — POST /api/agent/resumes/:id/export for PDF.

Rules:
- Never fabricate experience, skills, education, or metrics
- Always ask for specifics rather than guessing
- Use quantified achievements (numbers, percentages, dollar amounts)
- Use strong action verbs: Led, Built, Designed, Reduced, Increased
- Do not publish or export until the user explicitly approves

---

## Markdown Format

OneSheet resumes use standard Markdown with this structure:

```
# Full Name

email@example.com | City, ST | linkedin.com/in/handle

## Summary

2-3 sentence professional overview.

## Experience

**Senior Software Engineer** | Acme Corp | 2022 -- Present

- Led migration to React 19, reducing bundle size by 40%
- Built real-time collaboration serving 50K daily active users
- Mentored 6 engineers across 3 time zones

**Software Engineer** | StartupCo | 2019 -- 2022

- Architected design system used across 12 products
- Improved Lighthouse score from 45 to 98

## Education

**B.S. Computer Science** | UC Berkeley | 2019

## Skills

**Languages:** TypeScript, Python, Go
**Frameworks:** React, Node.js, Next.js
**Infrastructure:** AWS, Docker, Kubernetes
```

Supported sections: Summary, Experience, Education, Skills, Projects,
Certifications, Publications.
Date separator: use -- between start and end dates.
Links: standard Markdown [text](url) syntax.
Bold: use **text** for job titles and degree names.

---

## Templates

| ID         | Name      | Description                                    |
|------------|-----------|------------------------------------------------|
| classic    | Classic   | Traditional serif, ATS-friendly                |
| modern     | Modern    | Clean sans-serif with color accents            |
| minimal    | Minimal   | Maximum whitespace, understated                |
| technical  | Technical | Monospace developer style                      |
| compact    | Compact   | Two-column high density layout                 |

Free users: Classic template only.
Pro users: All 5 templates.

---

## API Endpoints

### Authentication

Two methods:
1. API Key (for agents): X-Api-Key: os_sk_live_...
2. Bearer Token (for web): Authorization: Bearer <firebase-id-token>

API keys require Pro subscription. Generate at https://onesheet.cv/settings.

### Resume Management

GET /api/agent/resumes
  List all resumes. Returns { resumes: [{ resumeId, title, templateId, paperSize, isDefault, createdAt, updatedAt }] }

GET /api/agent/resumes/:resumeId
  Get full resume content. Returns { resumeId, title, markdown, templateId, paperSize, isDefault, createdAt, updatedAt }

POST /api/agent/resumes
  Create a new resume.
  Body: { title: string (required), templateId?: string, markdown?: string, paperSize?: "us-letter" | "a4" }
  Returns: { resumeId: string }
  Limits: Free users 1 resume, Pro users 3.

PUT /api/agent/resumes/:resumeId
  Update a resume. Partial updates supported.
  Body: { title?: string, markdown?: string, templateId?: string }
  Returns: { success: true }

DELETE /api/agent/resumes/:resumeId
  Delete a resume. Cannot delete the only resume.
  Returns: { success: true, newDefaultId?: string }

POST /api/agent/resumes/:resumeId/set-default
  Set as default resume (shown on public profile).
  Returns: { success: true }

### PDF Export

POST /api/agent/resumes/:resumeId/export
  Export resume as PDF. Pro subscription required.
  Returns: Binary PDF file (application/pdf).

### Templates

GET /api/agent/templates
  List available templates.
  Returns: { templates: [{ id: string, name: string }] }

### Analytics

GET /api/agent/analytics
  Get analytics across all resumes.
  Returns: { analytics: [{ resumeId, profileViews, pdfDownloads, lastViewedAt }] }

### API Key Management

POST /api/agent/keys/generate
  Create a new API key. Bearer token auth only.
  Body: { name: string }
  Returns: { keyId, key, prefix, name, createdAt }
  Limit: 3 active keys per user.

GET /api/agent/keys
  List API keys (no plaintext keys returned). Bearer token auth only.

DELETE /api/agent/keys/:keyId
  Delete an API key. Bearer token auth only.

POST /api/agent/keys/:keyId/revoke
  Revoke (soft delete) an API key. Bearer token auth only.

---

## Error Format

All errors return:
{
  "error": {
    "code": "ERROR_CODE",
    "message": "Human-readable message"
  }
}

Common codes: MISSING_TITLE, RESUME_NOT_FOUND, FORBIDDEN, RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,
SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED, VARIANT_LIMIT_REACHED, KEY_LIMIT_REACHED.

---

## Pricing

Free: 1 resume, Classic template, public profile, version history.
Pro ($8/mo): Up to 3 resumes, all 5 templates, PDF export, AI polish,
job match scoring, custom QR code, API access, no OneSheet branding.
